content.v: 《灰区 战争 》的作弊问题近期引发部分玩家和内容创作者批评。开发商MADFINGER Games联合创始人兼CEO Marek Rabas在介绍游戏未来规划的媒体简报中回应称，团队正制定更完整的反作弊计划，目标是尽快识别作弊者并将其移出游戏。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1791006518_903834_jpg_r.jpg
Rabas表示，团队已多次讨论如何应对作弊。他承认开发团队无法禁止所有作弊行为，因此希望在作弊者出现后更快作出反应。目前公布的是处理方向，尚无具体的检测方法或处罚规则。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1791006526_621247_jpg_r.jpg
这项计划是在介绍即将推出的0.5版本“Rogue Ops”时提出的。简报称，该版本将对游戏作出较大调整，并加入第二条玩法循环，内容围绕被动收入、在Lamang建立生活以及向Ground Zero推进展开。
团队尚未公布反作弊计划的实施时间或已取得的成效。对于这项计划，Rabas目前明确提出的目标仍是提高发现和处理作弊者的速度。

content.v: 国庆长假正式开启之后，不少开新能源车自驾出行的车主都吐槽，如今在高速服务区排队充电依然是整个出行过程里最痛苦的环节。
国庆假期第一天，堵在路上的不只是高速主路的车流，连各个服务区的补能区也排起了长队，不管是直流充电桩还是换电站的通道，到处都是排队等着补能的电车。
有纯电车主在社交平台抱怨充电难度远超预期，连着走了4个服务区都没充上电，每个服务区的充电桩前都排了几十号车，自己取号之后拿到的是第169号，站在排队的队伍里当场觉得出行的好心情全没了。还有车主反馈，假期期间不少高速充电站出台了临时规则，所有车辆充电到80%就必须离场，机器后台自动设置了限流，根本没法继续往满充。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1791005568_457464_jpg_r.jpg
不少排了一两个小时队还没充上电的纯电车主吐槽，高速服务区的10个充电桩里，有8个都被混动、增程车型占着，这类车型本身油箱带油没有续航焦虑，但是很多车主开电之后舍不得用油，也挤到高速充电桩排队补电，本来就紧张的充电资源被进一步挤占，纯电车主的等待时间被拉得更长。
也有不少增程式车主站出来表达了不同的看法，他们表示自家车型的动力电池容量本身就比纯电车型小很多，充满电的耗时本来就短，不会长时间占用桩位，真要是碰到节假日高速充电桩排大队的情况，自己也可以直接切换燃油模式开到家附近再充电，不会非得挤在高速上抢桩。
根据国家智慧车联网平台的出行数据预测，整个国庆假期的高速充电峰值已经在10月1日到来，当天的充电高峰时段集中在7点到20点。接下来10月5日、6日是全国集中返程的核心时段，高速公路的充电车辆数量还会维持在高位运行，两天的充电高峰分别对应10月5日11时至21时，10月6日10时至22时。
资深汽车行业从业者刘浩指出，想要彻底解决节假日高速充电排队的痛点，首先要做的是补能基建的布局优化，车流量大的热门高速干线沿线，要直接成倍扩充服务区的充电桩数量;同时也要在高速出入口的周边城区大范围增设公共充电站，主动分流高速路段的集中补能压力。
其次高速服务区的充电桩资源可以尝试做分区动态管理，增程式或者混动车型可以引导到单独的专属充电区，或者优先引导这类没有续航焦虑的车辆下高速到周边城区补电;主流导航APP可以把各个服务区的实时充电排队人数、等待时长信息同步更新，让车主提前调整自己的充电规划。热门服务区还可以提前调配移动充电车、临时应急充电桩，在出行高峰时段作为补能补充力量。
不少已经体验过排队充电的车主都表示，这些优化措施落地之后，完全可以大幅降低节假日新能源车长途出行的补能焦虑，不用让大家自驾出游的大半时间都耗在排队等充电上，最终让新能源车的长途出行体验追上传统燃油车的便利程度。

items.title: 排队3小时充电1小时！新能源车国庆假日充电大考
items.summary: 这个国庆假期，高速服务区新能源车排队充电的名场面毫无意外再次上演，不少自驾出行的电车车主都被漫长的排队耗掉了大半出游兴致。

content.v: 这个国庆假期，高速服务区新能源车排队充电的名场面毫无意外再次上演，不少自驾出行的电车车主都被漫长的排队耗掉了大半出游兴致。
据央视新闻报道，国庆假期首日全国高速路网的新能源通行车辆预计达到1780万辆次，交通运输部专门发布出行提示，车流量排名靠前的重点高速干线、通往热门景区沿线的服务区车流密度极高，充电需求会非常集中，高峰时段基本都出现在每天10点之后。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261003_zy_red_164_6/1182.jpg
事实上不少选择提前错峰出行的新能源车车主，早在9月30日就已经碰到了高速服务区排队充电的糟心情况。
有车主在社交平台分享自己的经历，在云南曲靖卜嘎服务区取号之后，前面还排着26辆车，原地等了30分钟，回头一看自己身后又新添了20多辆等着补能的车，整条等待的车队在服务区广场上绕出了很长的队伍。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261003_zy_red_164_6/1336.jpg
这位车主9月30日下午2点就接连找了4个服务区想找空闲充电桩，一直耗到傍晚5点车辆剩余电量彻底见底，实在没办法只能在第四个服务区死等，前前后后足足排了3个小时才充上电。
还有网友算了一笔非常直观的出行时间账，他自己开传统油车和开电车的朋友同一天从同一个城市出发，他路上碰到一点轻微堵车，全程总共花了14小时抵达目的地。开电车的朋友中途要进服务区排队充电，还遇上了主路大堵车，全程加起来足足用了26个小时才到，差不多是油车耗时的两倍。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261003_zy_red_164_6/1557.jpg
国庆假期正式开启之后，排队充电的情况非但没有好转，反而变得更加严重，不少纯电车主忍不住吐槽，本来就不多的充电车位，一大半都被没有续航焦虑的增程、混动车型占住了，自己的等待时间被拉得更长。
根据交通运输部的出行数据预测，整个国庆假期选择自驾出行的新能源车数量远超日常，日均新能源出行车辆的规模，达到了日常平均水平的1.8倍。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261003_zy_red_164_6/1723.jpg
为了应对假期暴增的新能源车辆充电需求，交通运输部早在中秋国庆假期到来之前，就专门梳理建立了充电特别繁忙服务区清单，在这些排队高发的服务区临时调配移动充电车、新增大功率快充设备，尽可能缓解集中补能的压力。新能源车主还可以通过e路畅通微信小程序，一键查询全国高速服务区的实时充电排队情况，提前规划自己的补能路线。
不少车主都表示，如今新能源车的保有量每年都在快速上涨，现有的高速充电基建升级速度已经有点跟不上车辆增长的节奏，后续相关部门如果能推出更精细化的分流管理方案，就能大幅降低节假日的补能焦虑，让长途出行的体验再上一个台阶。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261003_zy_red_164_6/11250.jpg

items.title: 国足0-5耻辱性惨败巴勒斯坦 开局把球传对面解说懵逼

content.v: 据头条新闻报道，近日友谊赛，中国男足0-5不敌巴勒斯坦遭遇耻辱性惨败。比赛开场，国足开球直接踢给了巴勒斯坦球员，引发球迷讨论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261003_zy_red_164_5/166.jpg

对此，解说员李欣刚开始有些懵，他说：“呃……中国队换了一种新的开球方式，这种开球方式，相似的打法我们见过，就是一个大脚打到对方角旗附近的边线，出了边线，然后队员可以跟着压上，对方位置很深的边线球很不好处理，我们可以趁势到对方的半场。但今天中国队这个开球意图不是很清楚，因为打向了对方半场的腰部，没有出界，让对方就直接拿到了皮球。”刘越表示：“这可能就是一个长传的失误，本来想打到边线外边，结果直接传给对方左后卫脚下了。”李欣：“对方就可以马上获得球权开展进攻了。”刘越：“这个开球的方式最早发明的是巴黎圣日耳曼，恩里克发明的。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261003_zy_red_164_5/1333.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261003_zy_red_164_5/1335.jpg
而在本场这场耻辱性的惨败过后，站出来直面舆论压力的，却是队内年龄最小的赵松源。这样的采访安排引来大量球迷批评。17岁的赵松源是国足史上最年轻出场球员，就读清华附中，本次从U17梯队直接跳级升入成年国家队，本场比赛下半场替补登场。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261003_zy_red_164_5/1452.jpg
2009年出生的小将赵松源接受了采访。赵松源表示：“我觉得我们上下半场没有给对手足够的压力，让他们很轻易的就去拿球，然后出球，然后随意的做动作。我觉得我们需要把压迫给再强度再高一点。我觉得我们今天大家的态度，然后在场上的拼劲都非常好，然后可能对于一些细节处理没有做好，然后也希望下场能够取得好的成绩。希望自己能为球队做出更多的贡献，也希望自己能在场上拼尽全力。”

content.v: 网飞的游戏野心并未如愿落地，这早已不是秘密。这家流媒体巨头旗下的3A游戏开发工作室尚未推出任何作品就遭关停，其余收购来的独立工作室也在陆续解散。游戏业务是否还在网飞的未来规划中?联合首席执行官给出了肯定答案，只不过未来的重心将主要放在云游戏上。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790998724_262686_jpg_r.jpg
泰德·萨兰多斯本周出席了彭博社的“屏幕时间”峰会，会上有人问及（消息来源GameSpot）他是否认为五年后网飞仍会涉足游戏领域。他给出了如下回答：
我认为会的。事实上，如今最值得期待的方向是——移动游戏曾是通往云游戏的入口，而我们更感兴趣的是，用户能用手机当遥控器，在电视端实现更多游戏体验。要知道，在所谓的后主机时代，电视端游戏将迎来各式各样的发展机遇。
而我们希望成为这一领域的早期布局者。我看好游戏业务对IP的延伸作用，也很认可它的品牌价值——对于那些不想看剧、只想在屏幕前玩游戏的用户，我们也能提供对应的选择。
这番话听起来，网飞想做的是低成本的品牌联动小游戏，面向平时不怎么玩游戏的用户休闲消遣。这显然不是叙事驱动的沉浸式游戏——比如网飞旗下、曾推出《狼奔豕突》的夜校工作室，今年夏天推出的《失心疯》就属于这类作品。该工作室在数月后遭关停，这似乎也彻底宣告网飞打造高品质自研游戏内容的野心就此破灭。
会上也有人问及此事，以及网飞是否考虑收购大型游戏发行商，比如Take-Two，或是在微软决定拆分Xbox业务时购入其部分股权。这位网飞联合首席执行官表示，公司目前对收购的意愿并不高。
“大家都知道，我们历来就不是大举收购的企业，”他解释道，“抛开华纳兄弟的交易不谈，我们一直都是从零开始搭建业务。”萨兰多斯随后补充道：“我们的增长将主要依靠内生驱动，同时也会寻找能与现有业务形成互补的机会，游戏业务也遵循这一原则。”

content.v: 《纸片 马里奥 ：千年之门》Switch版保留了原版涂鸦中的“Game Cuve”拼写错误，只是把它藏进了虚构文字里。这一版本于2024年5月23日推出，作为2004年GameCube 经典 作品的高清重制版，它在画面表现上进行了全面升级，采用了立体故事书风格的美术设计，支持动态光影与场景反射效果。原版中那些曾让玩家会心一笑的细节，不少都在重制版中以更隐蔽的方式延续了下来。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790997614_239599_jpg_r.jpg
Super Mario Broth发布的发现显示，游戏里的虚构文字可与英语文本对应。原版涂鸦写着“Game Cuve”；Switch版改写了字形，但按对应关系解读后，得到的仍是“Game Cuve”。这种处理方式颇有意味：制作组显然注意到了原版的拼写失误，却没有选择直接修正或删除，而是用一种近乎“加密”的方式将它保留了下来。对于熟悉原版的老玩家来说，这成了一种需要主动发现才能触及的彩蛋。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790997617_922820_jpg_r.jpg
事实上，这种对原版细节的“再编码”在重制版中并非孤例。原版中斗技场迎接员Toad在第三章结束后总会咬到舌头的桥段，在Switch版中变成了一个随机触发的小概率事件，只有偶尔才会重现。类似地，如果马力欧恰好站在离地面一格的位置看向同伴，同伴会瞬移到身后，这个行为在原版中并不存在。这些改动看似细微，却透露出制作组对原作遗产的谨慎态度。
从“Game Cuve”的存留方式可以窥见重制工作的一种思路：既不粗暴地抹去过去的瑕疵，也不原封不动地照搬，而是通过视觉层面的重新演绎，让老细节在新语境下获得另一种存在方式。对于一款承载了二十年记忆的作品而言，这种处理或许比单纯的“修正”更能让老玩家感受到制作组的用心。

content.v: 快科技10月3日消息，近日，Neuralink高管希冯·齐里斯在社交平台发文，证实已与埃隆·马斯克分手，她表示，这场分开来得十分突然，一周前两人还在发短信互诉衷肠。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031104096036.png
希冯·齐里斯今年40岁，1986年出生于加拿大安大略省万锦市，拥有加拿大国籍，父亲是加拿大人，母亲是印度旁遮普裔移民，属于混血背景。
她本科就读于耶鲁大学，主修经济学与哲学，在校期间还是校冰球队守门员，学业和体育能力突出。
毕业后进入IBM从事金融科技工作，之后担任彭博旗下风投机构Bloomberg Beta创始合伙人，深耕人工智能领域，曾入选福布斯30位30岁以下投资人榜单，是AI圈内知名的风险投资人。

2016年她以顾问身份加入OpenAI，在此结识马斯克；2017年起，她加入马斯克阵营，先后担任特斯拉自动驾驶与芯片项目负责人，同时入职Neuralink担任核心高管，至今仍在负责脑机接口相关项目。
2020年前后，齐里斯因身体原因受孕困难但渴望拥有孩子，马斯克提出以精子捐赠者的身份，通过体外受精共同孕育后代，最初双方约定此事严格保密。
2021年11月，齐里斯生下一对龙凤胎；后续她又陆续生下两名孩子，前后一共和马斯克孕育四名子女，原本仅围绕孩子与工作合作的两人，之后发展成恋人关系。

items.title: 2XKO需数十万甚至百万玩家 这款新作上线即注定失败
items.summary: 在《柠檬水摊》播客中，拳头游戏联合创始人马克·梅里尔表示：“这事只能怪我们自己，对吧?我认为我们原本有机会做出一番成果，真正为格斗游戏社群添力，但《街头霸王6》正式发售——彼时距离我们着手开发《2XKO》已经过去了整整八

content.v: 在《柠檬水摊》播客中，拳头游戏联合创始人马克·梅里尔表示：
“这事只能怪我们自己，对吧?我认为我们原本有机会做出一番成果，真正为格斗游戏社群添力，但《街头霸王6》正式发售——彼时距离我们着手开发《2XKO》已经过去了整整八年。我们的开发团队十分优秀，成员个个才华横溢，工作成果斐然，打造出了一款品质出众的游戏。
“……这款游戏确实收获了一部分玩家的喜爱，但玩家规模远远不足以支撑它最初设计的长线运营服务型模式……以他们的成本结构来看，要维持长线服务，月活跃用户至少得达到数十万量级，甚至得上百万。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790996505_811743.jpg
《2XKO》已终止开发（梅里尔将其粉饰为转而做成“买断制游戏”，但事实上拳头为了推进这一调整还裁掉了大批员工）。此事让不少玩家深感失望，但考虑到游戏行业今年整体处境艰难，倒也不算意外。然而，“数十万起，甚至上百万”这个玩家数要求，实在有些离谱。
尤其值得注意的是，播客里专门标注了这是月活跃用户（MAU），想来应该是节目组向梅里尔确认过的。月活跃用户指的是一个月内至少登录并进行过一次操作的独立用户，这一数值远高于同时在线用户数——即同一时间点的登录用户数量。
不过我们至少可以做个粗略估算。在撰写本文时，《街头霸王6》PC端的同时在线峰值为3万人。我们假设普通人每天有7小时的可游戏时间，考虑到朝九晚五的工作，或是周末的家务和社交安排，同时在线人数其实不会有太大波动。
也就是说，在24小时周期内，任意时刻的在线玩家约占潜在玩家总数的30%-35%。剩下的人要么在睡觉、上班，要么在处理琐事。这样算下来，《街头霸王6》PC端每天稳定游玩的人数大概在10万左右。
我得说明：这绝对不是准确数字，只是餐巾纸式的粗略估算——假设《街头霸王6》的玩家在各个时区均匀分布，且每个人的日常作息都相同。但没办法，我只能基于现有数据推算，毕竟卡普空并未公开月活跃用户数据。
我们再往最宽松的方向算，假设只有25%的玩家在PC端游玩（实际占比很可能更高，我这是刻意往保守了算），那全天24小时的总玩家数也才40万。而月活跃用户统计的只是“这个人本月有没有登录过”。假设《街头霸王6》没有新玩家流入，那每天40万的总玩家数，对月活数据的提升非常有限。
这意味着，要想让月独立玩家数接近百万，每天都得有大量新玩家或是回归玩家涌入。2023年6月至2026年6月期间，《街头霸王6》总销量为700万份。就算把销量平摊到这36个月里（实际不可能，游戏销量通常集中在发售初期），每个月新增的潜在玩家也只有19.44万左右。
换句话说，就算拿全球最热门的格斗游戏之一来算，对日活数往最宽松的方向估算，还刻意压低PC端占比来佐证观点，最终月活也才刚过50万。连“数十万量级”的门槛都勉强够到，更别说上百万了。
再和其他仍在持续更新的格斗游戏对比，这个要求就更显得不切实际。《罪恶装备：奋战》至今还在推出新角色和更新内容，它的24小时同时在线峰值才1580人。
说白了：《2XKO》根本不可能达到预期的玩家规模，这背后留下了诸多疑问。拳头这家公司是不是在非小众品类的成功里变得过于自负了?他们压根没做过市场调研吗?还是说《2XKO》的开发团队效率极低?
又或者，它只是和之前的很多工作室一样，仗着资金充足就赌一把，看看能不能做出比《街头霸王6》更优秀的作品——拿着开发人员的生计当赌注?这些问题的答案，没一个能让人觉得体面。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031048324774.png
随着《街头霸王》真人电影上映进入倒计时，饰演春丽的加拿大华裔女演员Callina Liang（卡莉娜·梁）正在展开密集的宣传行程。她发布的全新宣传照，迅速在社交媒体上引发讨论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031048336802.png

《街头霸王》真人电影由传奇影业与卡普空联合出品，是派拉蒙影业与传奇娱乐达成三年全球发行协议后的首部作品。影片由Kitao Sakurai执导，演员阵容相当豪华：安德鲁·浩二饰演隆，诺亚·琴蒂内奥饰演肯，Callina Liang饰演春丽，David Dastmalchian出演反派M. Bison，WWE巨星Roman Reigns饰演豪鬼，Jason Momoa饰演Blanka，50 Cent饰演Balrog。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031054098252.png
故事讲述1993年，昔日并肩作战的街头战士隆与肯因神秘女子春丽的现身，被重新召回“世界格斗大赛”的擂台。影片以IMAX格式拍摄，定于2026年10月16日在北美及全球多地同步上映。

Callina Liang于2000年5月14日出生于加拿大温哥华，为了演好这位“世界上最强女人”，Liang经历了一场近乎自虐的体型改造。她在接受《Empire》杂志采访时透露，从确认选角到开拍只有三个月时间，期间她每天进行两小时的跆拳道、泰拳和武术训练，配合大量腿部力量训练，每天摄入约4000卡路里，并在增肌阶段被要求每隔两小时进食一次、每天吃下12颗鸡蛋。最终她的双腿围度增加了6.5厘米，呈现出符合春丽标志性踢击动作的肌肉线条。
她还把历代《街头霸王》游戏下载到PS5上，用手机录下春丽的所有招式，以慢动作逐帧研究“百裂脚”的动作节奏。这种敬业态度让不少原本对真人化持怀疑态度的玩家转变了看法。

content.v: 无线游戏鼠标体验出色，且随着技术迭代愈发完善。事实上它的表现已经足够优秀，若非追求极致性价比，我绝不会选择有线款。然而在上海举办的《无畏契约》冠军赛上，有线鼠标反倒成了最优解——现场的定制赛事桌似乎会干扰无线信号。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790995269_110753.jpg
《无畏契约》电竞官方X账号近日表示，“鼠标信号干扰问题反复出现，导致多次触发技术暂停，打乱了我们本年度最重要赛事的进程”，官方将要求所有选手改用有线鼠标，直至问题解决。
在FUT Esports对阵100 Thieves的比赛中，选手xeus的鼠标出现了无法开火的故障。xeus效力的FUT战队最终以0比2不敌100 Thieves。
拳头官方称：“赛后官方评估认定，本场比赛本应允许进行回合回溯。我们对这一失误承担全部责任。”拳头同时表示：“综合考量所有可行方案后，我们决定维持本场比赛结果不变。因为其他方案都会推翻一支战队的胜利，而这支战队在同等条件下参赛，对此次故障并无责任。”
拳头为本次赛事专门定制了金属赛事桌，官方认为材质选择很可能是造成信号干扰的根源。对大部分选手来说，只需将无线鼠标切换为有线模式即可，但部分没有USB-C接口的鼠标（比如新款赛睿Rival Pro）会面临很大问题。
这种情况下，职业选手就得彻底更换鼠标，这意味着要重新适应新的外形、重量和手感。在顶级职业赛场，这可能会造成轻微的竞技劣势。
但即便沿用原本的鼠标，插上线缆连接设备也会带来小麻烦——鼠标移动时会增加额外的拖拽阻力。这很可能意味着很多选手在赛事期间都得略微调整操作习惯，至少要等到问题修复。
无线鼠标在职业选手中如此流行是有原因的：它移动灵活，手臂操作时无需考虑线缆的拖拽束缚，且如今的轮询率已经足够高，无线鼠标的响应速度与有线鼠标不相上下。不管这个问题能多快解决，对职业选手来说都算是不小的波折，或许以后他们都会随身多带一根备用USB线。

content.v: 美国AI企业Anthropic即将冲刺美股上市，根据市场消息显示公司目标IPO估值达2万亿美元，计划募资最高1000亿美元。
如果这一估值落地，Anthropic将超越SpaceX今年6月上市时1.77万亿美元的发行估值，刷新全球史上最大IPO纪录！
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790994937_710245.png
Anthropic是知名大模型Claude的研发企业，谷歌、亚马逊为其主要投资方，同时为公司提供算力支撑。
公司核心业务是通过Claude产品、企业API和云平台，向客户提供模型能力，企业可以将Claude接入自己的业务系统，也可以使用建立在模型之上的工具。
其中Claude Code便是一个极其重要的工具，通过读取代码库、修改文件、执行命令，能持续完成较长链条的工作。
早在今年6月Anthropic就已向美国SEC秘密递交上市申请，承销团队由摩根士丹利、高盛、摩根大通牵头，按照最新时间表，公司计划最快11月完成上市，部分安排或将在美国中期选举结束之后推进。
招股相关材料披露，Anthropic测算自身可触及的潜在市场规模超过30万亿美元，以此支撑2万亿的估值预期。
财务层面，公司营收增速迅猛，已从2024财年的3.86亿美元增至2025财年的45.9亿美元，但同期净亏损高达420亿美元，资本开支压力巨大。
公司提示风险，其收入高度依赖少数大客户，且客户大多没有签订长期固定合同，存在订单流失风险。
当前资本市场正在密切观察，这宗AI超级IPO能否兑现市场的高期待，也将影响全球科技初创企业后续的估值逻辑。

others.title: 《命运 2》可能会回归，但 Bungie 商店将消失

content.v: Another unexpected twist in the Bungle tale:

After more than a decade of serving our players through the Bungie Store, we are retiring the current storefront for Bungie and Destiny related merchandise on October 19. We are building a new home for our merchandise that's more aligned with our current goals and vision. We'll… October 2, 2026

That's the latest move from Bungie, which recently un-cancelled Destiny 2 following a massive fan backlash over the decision to put the game in maintenance mode. It seems odd to me—I would think that now, with the seeming rebirth of Destiny 2 at hand, is exactly the time you'd want that storefront up and operational. Regardless of the need for a new storefront, taking the old one offline for months while it's being made feels counterproductive.

Also interesting is that the Marathon storefront, which lives on its own subdomain , is not being taken offline while the "new home" is being built. They look effectively identical, so I have no idea what to make of that.
Here's a little comparison of the two:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/h2UGhQZi8XtQxnD6aXGxWU-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/tdYJDVq25Q9oEJrdX6JTPU-1920-80.png

At a guess, I'd say the most likely outcome here is that the Bungie Store will be integrated into Sony's own storefront—rather like Bungie's own absorption into Sony after the wheels came off the whole "independent subsidiary" thing.

Some followers hope that will lead to lower shipping costs, which would be a positive outcome of sorts, although Sony taking control of the whole endeavor could mean a more limited selection of stuff going forward. That's entirely speculative, but that's also the whole Bungie/Destiny 2 situation in a nutshell: Something is happening, but exactly what we just cannot pin down at this point.
What we can pin down is that the Bungie Store as we know it will close on October 19, while digital downloads and emblem codes will remain accessible until December 31. Get 'em while you can.

content.v: 通常我很反感身家数十亿的企业动辄祭出“找我们法务部门谈”的大棒，打压那些零预算、只是想施展创意的模组制作者，但这一回我却觉得无可厚非：贝塞斯达向一名“AI创作者”下发了停止侵权禁令，此人制作了一款背景设在纽约、可直接在浏览器运行的《辐射》同人游戏。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790994468_163906.jpg
这么说其实有点抬举它了：据克里斯·弗斯特在X平台的推文（via RPS）中解释，他只是“指挥克劳德以及一整个AI智能体工作室”替自己做出了这款游戏。弗斯特还称，整个过程完全没有注入任何新的创意，他要求做的游戏“并非受《辐射》启发”，而是要“和《辐射》一模一样”。
成品就是这么来的。
我知道浏览器运行本身就是一种限制，但这款游戏的质量实在差到我完全不想碰。它和《辐射：伦敦》《天际湮没》这类模组形成了天壤之别——那些作品倾注了制作者真正的热情、投入与创意。诚然，这些大型模组工程浩大，需要数百名志愿者花费数年时间打磨，但至少它们质量过关，我觉得这里面或许有值得反思的地方。
不管怎么说，我想不想玩现在都已经无关紧要了，因为弗斯特昨天表示，他收到了ZeniMax传媒的通知，要求他停止该项目——具体来说，他为这个项目注册的域名fallout.nyc侵犯了工作室的知识产权。
我不知道弗斯特是不是指望大家同情他的遭遇，但看样子没多少人买账。有人批评他直接把项目命名为“辐射”，摆明了就是挑衅贝塞斯达出手;也有不少人抨击他用AI制作游戏的行为。少数乐观人士觉得只要改个名字就没事了，但弗斯特似乎并不打算这么做。
这或许反而是件好事：也许我话说得太重了（不过我并不这么觉得），但改名这个方案有个显而易见的问题——改名改变不了它本身粗制滥造的事实。在浏览器里玩一款低多边形的《辐射》算不上什么厉害的技术成就——《上古卷轴3：晨风》也能做到同样的事，而且人家至少还能还原《晨风》的样子。如果你只想玩便宜的《辐射》，《辐射3》在Steam秋季特惠只卖2.49美元，花五美元就能拿下《辐射：新维加斯》。
我倒能理解弗斯特想要一款正经新《辐射》的心情：我对这套玩法也有点腻了，但距离《辐射4》发售已经过去11年，这时间实在太长了。但就像年轻人说的，这玩意儿根本不是那么回事。虽然我永远不会站在企业那边摇旗呐喊，但看着这个项目被扫进历史的垃圾桶——它也确实只配待在那儿——我一点都不觉得可惜。

items.title: 《爱情》和《深空》开发者在致命饮料食谱疯传后向玩家发出警告
items.summary: The official social media account for the popular RPG-dating sim Love and Deepspace issued a warning to player

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/03/love-and-deepspace-devs-issue-warning-deadly-drink-recipes-1790993773020.jpg

The official social media account for the popular RPG-dating sim Love and Deepspace issued a warning to players after announcing some fictional cocktails with potentially disastrous real-world consequences if actually consumed.

On September 28, Love and Deepspace revealed five ‘Shimmering Blend’ cocktail recipes as part of an in-game event, each themed around one of the game’s dashing romanceable characters. While they’re pretty to look at, you shouldn’t actually make some of these, as they include garnishes that are poisonous to humans.
For example, one of these drinks is made of pomegranate juice, with a garnish of cinnamon and datura. Another features sweet peach juice with a flame lily garnish and gelatin sheets.

There’s nothing wrong with peach and pomegranate juice, but these floral garnishes are making some players anxious that a fan might actually try to out the recipes themselves. Datura is a highly poisonous plant and is considered psychoactive ; when consumed, it produces side effects like delirium, fever, tachychardia, and hallucinations.

Flame Lilies are also dangerous, as all parts of the plant contain a chemical called colchicine; while it’s used for medicinal purposes, it can be lethal , causing symptoms like fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and even hypovolemic shock, which causes the loss of lethal amounts of blood and bodily fluids.

It didn’t take long for concerned fans to point out these dangerous plants, fearing that some players might try their hand at making the cocktails for real. Commenters flooded the replies with calls for the Love and Deepspace account to delete the post completely, with one writing , “Delete this. This is literal poison. Nobody make this.”
Safety Notice: All drinks shown are fictional and for in-game purposes only. Do not attempt to recreate or consume them in reality.
“Hey, so some of these flowers are literally poisonous. Be careful. This is so reckless to post this,” another said .
"Don't try to recreate these drinks, they contain toxic plants!" yet another warned . "I can't believe this is posted as 'recipes.'"

Not long after, the LaDS account added a follow-up post with a safety notice, which reads: “All drinks shown are fictional and for in-game purposes only. Do not attempt to recreate or consume them in reality.”

In addition to calls from fans to delete the posts, the LaDS social media accounts continue to be flooded with photos of canceled love interest Valko , who was announced and subsequently canned before he was even released. This prompted an impressive movement from the game’s playerbase, who created shrines to the character and even gathered outside the developer’s physical offices to make their voices heard.

items.summary: 索尼近日推送的PS5固件14.1版本，可能直接决定了谁能玩到《GTA6》

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030907193255.png
索尼近日推送的PS5固件14.1版本，可能直接决定了谁能玩到《GTA6》。据PlaystationGameSize消息，《GTA6》PS5版将要求系统固件版本不低于14.1（即26.06-14.10.00），这意味着所有停留在可越狱固件上的主机，都将无法运行这款游戏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030908035961.png
14.1固件于10月1日紧急上线，距离上一个版本14.0仅隔两周，补丁体积仅1.2GB，核心目的就是封堵刚刚曝光的PS5 Relapse越狱漏洞。Relapse漏洞影响固件7.00至13.60，提供了内核级读写权限，可以让破解主机运行自制程序和游戏备份。目前越狱社区支持的固件版本最高仅到13.60，与《GTA6》要求的14.1之间存在明确断层。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030908054927.png
对于普通玩家而言，这件事的影响很直接：如果你打算在11月19日首发当天玩到《GTA6》，就需要将主机更新到最新的14.1固件。而选择留在低版本、保留越狱能力的玩家，则相当于主动放弃了对这款2026年最重磅作品的运行权限。索尼尚未就固件要求与《GTA6》的关联作出官方说明，但时间点上的高度吻合已经足够说明问题。

items.title: 《艾希》新作绝不NTR恶心玩家 但会攻击Sweet Baby
items.summary: 《艾希：续》制作人老马克肖在近日的直播中，就玩家关心的剧情走向做出明确表态

content.v: 《艾希：续》制作人老马克肖在近日的直播中，就玩家关心的剧情走向做出明确表态。他承诺本作剧情“非常正能量”，与前作结局保持同一情感思路，绝不会故意用私货内容恶心玩家。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030850308841.png

针对玩家最担心的NTR问题，老马克肖直接回应：“我知道你们担心什么，比如说什么NTR。我这里真的要吐槽一下，你们想想看，游戏里面实际互动的角色就那几个。就《艾希：续》里面，男女旁白加上艾希，没了。”他进一步解释，其他角色如达哈尔和崔妮蒂有自己独立的故事线，“他们彼此之间是CP，你总不能拆吧？”至于艾希的感情归属，他的回答很明确：“艾希还能和谁组CP呢？她不就是和玩家组CP的吗？我自己都不喜欢这种NTR的东西。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030854196335.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030854507871.png
老马克肖最后补了一句：“真的有恶意的话，也就只有diss Sweet Baby了。”《艾希：续》目前已开启众筹，原定1万元的目标已筹得超过1265万元。
Sweet Baby Inc.（简称SBI）是一家总部位于加拿大蒙特利尔的叙事设计与咨询工作室，由前育碧编剧金·贝莱尔（Kim Belair）和产品经理达维德·贝达尔（David Bédard）于2018年创立，团队规模约16人。其核心业务是为游戏开发团队提供叙事咨询，以多元、平等与包容（DEI）为框架，协助审查和编辑游戏脚本、塑造角色与故事线。
SBI的客户覆盖Xbox游戏工作室、EA、育碧、圣莫尼卡工作室等几乎所有欧美大厂，围绕其参与方式与影响范围，玩家群体自2024年起掀起了大规模争议与抵制，SBI由此成为游戏行业“政治正确”讨论中最具符号意义的争议焦点。

items.title: 《GTA6》全新截图与细节 露西亚大姐风范太飒了
items.summary: LOVE杂志发布了《GTA6》的最新一批截图

others.title: 全新《GTA 6》截图聚焦露西亚和杰森的关系

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030838086628.png
LOVE杂志发布了《GTA6》的最新一批截图，并披露了更多游戏细节。其中，游戏中的一个新地区 “Ambrosia” 被描述为一座虚构的糖业小镇，灵感来源于佛罗里达州的克莱维斯顿和奥基乔比湖。截图显示，该地区出现了由 Allied Crystals 赞助的“Vote Erin Henshaw”竞选标志，暗示游戏中的政治与商业元素将进一步交织。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030838103257.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030840208575.png

在游戏内容方面，本作将包含竞选自动电话、电台广告以及政治脱口秀等丰富的媒体形式，进一步强化开放世界的沉浸感。Rockstar表示，游戏中实际上不存在真正的“背景”，玩家周围始终有事件在发生。写作总监James Horton解释称，世界被设计成让对话和事件在玩家穿过繁忙区域时“冲刷过你”，而非强行打断玩家行动。Rupert Humphries则补充说，Rockstar的讽刺手法重在夸张、怪诞、超越现实，而非简单镜像现实，创作灵感部分来自阴谋论以及公众对日常事件的奇异反应。
技术层面，Rockstar联合主管Rob Nelson表示，游戏在某些时候会优先考虑真实感以增强沉浸，而在另一些时候则会为了玩家便利而牺牲真实感。这种取舍贯穿于开放世界的设计与交互逻辑之中。目前《GTA6》已确认将于2026年11月19日登陆PS5和Xbox Series X|S平台。

items.title: 《TOEM 2》：黑白使彩色惊艳，轻量让旅行纯粹
items.summary: 《TOEM 2》不仅满足了前作粉丝的期待，其极低的门槛和纯粹的休闲性质，也让它成为适合绝大多数玩家的电子旅行。

content.v: https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/headpic/2026/09/head-2621lo-banner1.jpg
作为一款以黑白手绘风画面和摄影解谜为核心的独立游戏， 《摄影冒险 2》 （TOEM2，下称《TOEM 2》）不仅满足了前作粉丝的期待，其极低的门槛和纯粹的休闲性质，也让它成为适合绝大多数玩家的电子旅行。如果你玩过《TOEM》，估计还记得那段追寻胜景的旅途，尽管在游戏流程中，我们的主角一直都轻盈地到处玩乐，但对玩家而言，历经重重任务与解谜挑战，爬上雪山看见极光的那一刻更像是一种朝圣。
继承前作气质的同时，《TOEM 2》为游戏体验做了减法，使其近似一次轻装上阵的故地重游。至于变化，主要体现在对美术及游玩驱动力进行了重构，而这两层重构最后以同一种语言指向了这部作品——乃至整个系列——真正有趣的关键：旅行感。
这张图片包含对《TOEM》结局的剧透 请点击后再查看
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P010605we.jpg
所谓减法，最直观的感知在于游戏体量的缩减。《TOEM 2》比初作少了一张地图，整体内容量大约缩减了四分之一，纯流程通关时间被控制在大约 4 小时左右。在实际体验中，这种缩减让人稍感不够尽兴，但并没有带来类似内容贫乏的空虚感，反而让整个流程愈发紧凑和流畅。
流畅首先归功于小地图的加入。在初作中，玩家需要耗费一定精力去记忆哪些岔路口还没有探索，而本作中的小地图彻底接管了这项工作。现在，你只需要为每张地图规划好路线，轻松转上两圈，基本就能水到渠成地集齐过关所需的印章。与此同时，入口也有了明显区分，玩家能够更清晰地分辨出哪些通往一个更具探索价值的新区域，哪些通往孤立的建筑内部。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P02160400.jpg
其次，本作大幅减少了满地图找特定物品的任务。探索过程中，玩家不再需要时刻惦记数个任务的寻物要求，到达新场景也不再需要马上打开相机查看是否有需要拍摄的地方，这同样解放了玩家的精力。
减轻负担后，玩家节约下来的精力随时可以转化为他们举起相机拍摄的动力，旅行感的营造真正具备了基础。

一旦举起相机，《TOEM》系列的交互逻辑里最不起眼但极其关键的设计就在第一时间呈现： 不操作相机时，游戏采用等距视角；一旦举起相机，便切换为第一人称视角。 系列两作一脉相承，也都有通过相机凝视、聚焦某物的互动方式——只有在镜头里，某些细节才会显现。这看起来理所当然，但确实称得上是系列的核心设计，将旅行和拍摄这两个关键词有机结合。切换机制本身就是一种表达，在设计层面也有作用，它使得拍照不只是任务，还成了探索的延伸。想要更好地观察世界，就得把相机举起来。

《TOEM 2》删除了前作的特写机制，这似乎减少了一些游玩乐趣，但更令人担心的可能是：那些重要的 NPC 因为缺少特写而变得不那么令人印象深刻。不过，本作用更传统的叙事方法弥补了这一点。玩家每次进入新地图，都会在门口遇到一位主线 NPC，这位 NPC 不仅会出现在地图各处帮助玩家推进任务线，还会给予主角一个全新的解谜工具。玩家可以用相机和物体交互来使用这些工具，它们不仅在主线中必不可少，在各类支线任务中同样大有用武之地，这种功能性绑定使得 NPC 的存在感得到弥补。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P0316640E.jpg
此外，本作的摄影挑战比前作更为有趣，要求玩家进行交互来营造出或者说想象出摄影目标。前作中的摄影挑战，本质上大多是字谜：NPC 给出一段描述，玩家根据描述去拍摄对应的事物；本作则在此基础上融合地图交互，需要玩家自己组织画面，更考验玩家的想象力。
本作的另一个质变来自跳跃机制。还记得前作最后一张地图，角色爬山需要与绳索交互并等待好几秒的迟滞感吗？本作中，主角终于学会了无缝跳跃，这不仅让跑图变得更加丝滑，也让地图的纵向结构得到了拓展。许多盖章任务中顺理成章地融入了轻度平台跳跃元素，整个探索空间的层次感丰富了许多。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P0417035r.jpg

初看《TOEM 2》的画面，老玩家可能会有一点不适应：初作那种手工风格、仿佛立体书般的贴图方块不见了，取而代之的是规整的实体建模。开发资源充裕后的技术升级是原因之一，而视觉材质的改变恰好为本作的旅行感提供了坚实支撑：初作的画面像是处在一个玩具盒内，分辨物体不够直观，玩家更依赖用相机的识别框进行扫描来观察场景。而精细建模则使得本作场景更具象、更贴近生活，玩家不再依赖扫描并分析场景来完成盖章任务，从而使得举起相机这一行为更加轻松、自由。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P051720JZ.png

从成品反推，本作美术方案的改变，未必只是技术升级。过滤掉色彩信息的黑白画面中，形状、明暗和空间层次承担了更多识别功能，而本作新增的跳跃机制与纵向地图拓展，其平台边缘、可攀爬处、建筑体块都需要更清晰的提示。精细建模让家具、建筑和杂物在黑白色调下形成更丰富的剪影与层次，也让拍照构图更为游刃有余。代价是作品在游戏市场中的辨识度下降，部分前作粉丝可能会觉得遗憾，但贯穿系列的拍照玩法和黑白配色共同构建的系列特质依然成立。

有趣的是，真正玩进去以后，玩家几乎不会因本作的画面配色产生单调感，因为游戏所营造的世界足够“丰富多彩”，特殊照片以及贴图上的质感纹理也冲淡了黑白带来的乏味。在视觉上，全程黑白并非单纯的审美偏好，而是一种情感控制策略。 它先让玩家习惯黑白，而后在结局引出 TOEM 现象，爆发出全程唯一的彩色画面，前期所有的克制便瞬间转化为极具冲击力的情感高潮。正因为全程黑白，那唯一的彩色才成了真正的“现象”——不只是好看，也能带来某种感动，创造某种能被称为 TOEM 的时刻。
这张图片包含对《TOEM 2》结局的剧透 请点击后再查看
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P061847Dt.png
某种意义上，黑白是视觉减法，减到极致，才让 TOEM 现象 成为爆发点；玩法上亦做减法，减到负担消失，才让旅游和拍照真正成立。两者共同作用，画面表现与玩法循环达成了完全的一致。这未必是创作者在立项之初的唯一意图，但从成品来看，黑白与彩色、减法与加法，在《TOEM 2》中恰好呈现为一套有迹可循的设计逻辑。
对于没有玩过《TOEM》的玩家，或许很难理解为什么这样一部轻度解谜作品能获得如此广泛的青睐。而要探讨《TOEM 2》的乐趣，终究要回到它的两大要素：旅行与拍照。前文大致梳理了本作如何更好地营造旅行感，最后一部分，我们更进一步，直接探讨为什么旅行和拍照能够有趣。
其实，对于大部分玩家来说，旅行玩法的乐趣很容易理解。虽然我们一直将其体验称为“旅行感”，但它实际上等同于冒险游戏中的探索，伴随着的往往是未知空间带来的惊喜和刺激。不过，讨论本系列时，我还是更愿意称探索体验为旅行感，毕竟二者确实大有不同，后者更轻盈，更自由，过程中没有跌宕起伏的冲击，只有纯粹的欣赏与游玩。
而拍照似乎复杂得多。在步行模拟摄影游戏中，如何让拍照变得有趣，一直是个难题。有的作品将拍照与环境叙事绑定，用拍照作为叙事线索；有的则靠设立奇观异景，把充满美学价值的物件摆放在环境中，激起玩家拍照的欲望。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P072241tD.png
这些方法确实有效，但往往挑人，且没那么适合轻量级探索解谜作品。既然如此，《TOEM》系列索性返璞归真：借探索和解谜营造的游戏空间容纳大量搞怪的 NPC 和环境彩蛋，激起玩家按快门的欲望。换言之，它不直接给玩家一个为拍照而生的景观，而是在用旅游的情境来催生玩家的拍照冲动。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P082261ZA.png
前述《TOEM 2》的所有减负改动，都是为了给这种独特的拍照冲动腾出精力。可以看出，设计者极力避免让这一作变成一个严丝合缝的箱庭，或是枯燥的收集马拉松。它剥离了那些会产生压力的系统，于是，玩家得以沉浸在“我正在旅游”的松弛状态中，自然产生拍照的冲动。而随着这种冲动得到满足，“有趣”从何而来就显而易见了。
这样一来，我们可以得出一个极具价值的结论：正是因为续作减少了功利性拍照任务，反而使得玩家的随手一拍更多出现、更加自然。游戏更少强制你把镜头对准某个特定的目标，而是将按下快门的主动权真正交还给了玩家。这就是《TOEM 2》4 小时的短暂旅途中，与 TOEM 现象 一样出彩的设计巧思。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P0923149j.png

items.title: 《牛来》国内票房超越新《超人》 达6397万元
items.summary: 《牛来》累计票房正式超越了詹姆斯·古恩执导的DC新片《超人》在内地6393万元的最终票房成绩。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021636017247.png
一部制作成本仅千余元的国产动画，在内地票房上完成了一次令人意外的反超。《牛来》累计票房约6397万元，正式超越了詹姆斯·古恩执导的DC新片《超人》在内地6393万元的最终票房成绩。
《牛来》于2026年8月5日上映，由导演信雨萌与母亲孙丽芳两人耗时五年“手搓”完成，全片未使用AI，制作设备购自二手平台，核心成本仅千余元。上映前9天，影片累计票房仅7169元，观影人次236人。随着粗糙画面和荒诞台词在社交平台引发大量吐槽与二次创作，影片热度骤升，8月15日单日票房升至71.6万元，两天后达到820.1万元，排片从个位数激增至上千场。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021636119961.png
《超人》由詹姆斯·古恩编剧并执导，制作成本高达2.25亿美元，大卫·科伦斯韦饰演超人，全球票房最终突破5亿美元。然而在中国内地市场，《超人》首周末票房仅约4800万元，最终停留在6393万元左右，成为近年来DC超英电影在华表现最冷淡的开局之一。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021636125725.png

items.title: 《深渊终结》补丁在发布一天后就修复了我的大部分投诉
items.summary: I spent a few days playing Section 9 Interactive's creepy metroidvania and writing my End of Abyss review , an

content.v: I spent a few days playing Section 9 Interactive's creepy metroidvania and writing my End of Abyss review , and ultimately concluded it was a fun but inconsistent experience hindered by a few particular issues. Now, just a day after it launched on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via the Epic Games Store, the studio has already cleared up most of those issues with a newly released patch .

If you missed the review, my main concern was how the in-game map would sometimes share incorrect information, like telling me a door was locked when I had unlocked it, or failing to signify when I'd found the key to a particular door. In a metroidvania, this means a whole lot. End of Abyss is a game about exploration, including lots of backtracking via roundabout paths, so when I'd plan long treks across the world based on a faulty map, it was really frustrating to find out too late that I'd essentially been lied to.

But a patch has fixed that, among other problems, and it presents an uncommon issue for me. My review only went out two days ago. The game only launched yesterday. Now much of my review is already outdated. In this era of live-service games and post-launch updates, it's common for games to change shape over time, but for End of Abyss's patch to fix many of its lesser parts essentially right after the deadline isn't normally how it goes.
Usually big, important changes happen in one of two ways:

In one common scenario, a game that critics are playing for review may be patched during that pre-release review period. It's often the case that critics are made aware of bugs we might see, and we're usually told when they've been patched out, or that those fixes are in the "day one" patch that comes with the game's public launch, leaving us to confirm as much once the patch drops.

This even applies to End of Abyss. I bumped into a few bugs during my time with the game, and the very worst of them--in which a boss failed to drop a quest item--was patched just a few hours before I had to write my review, allowing me to beat the game on time. This made the issue irrelevant to my review, and thus I didn't even specifically call it out.

If the public wasn't going to experience it, then I take it as my job to basically erase it from my memory of the experience--or at least, if I do mention it, I should explain how it's no longer a concern for players jumping in at launch.

In another common scenario, a game changes shape much later in its lifespan, and probably over the course of several updates. Games like Sea of Thieves, Overwatch, and Fallout 76 are great examples. These kinds of games often become the subject of re-reviews years later. But it's not just multiplayer games that do this. Games such as Starfield, Mass Effect 3, and Cyberpunk 2077 have been affected by such major changes that they merited follow-ups, too.

But End of Abyss is a much rarer case. The game just came out. My review could only speak to my experience, and so it does, but I'd planned to revisit it once my biggest problems with it were addressed and write something like what I've written here--something that says, "Hey, it's better now!" when I could recommend it with more confidence. I just didn't expect that would be a mere 48 hours after I published my thoughts on the game.

Section 9's debut landed in a weird gray area, where some important fixes came neither early enough for my review to consider them, nor late enough for my review to feel like it accurately reflected the experience of playing the game for a reasonable period of time. As it stands, only the players who jumped in yesterday--likely a relative few compared to the many more who will play the game over the next several years--bumped into the map issue I had during my time with it. No one else will ever have to deal with it.
That's good for players, and good for the studio, even if it leaves reviews like mine feeling more swiftly outdated than anything I can remember writing.

items.title: GTA 6 营销噱头显示我们的英国编辑都没有听说过迈阿密热火队
items.summary: I don't even know ball but I feel like I'm losing my mind.

content.v: At 8:35 am Central Time on Friday, October 2, PC Gamer audience development manager Cameron Bald shared a Twitter post by fan account GTA 6 Countdown . Miami's NBA basketball team, the Heat, is doing a cross-promotion event with Rockstar, " A Night in Vice City ." The team will temporarily rebrand, though from what I can tell it's as "Vice City" and not "The Vice City Heat," which feels weird but what do I know.

None of us were particularly enthused by the branding exercise, but noted negative nelly and Glasgow-based PCG online editor, Fraser Brown, took particular umbrage, wondering "Who the hell doesn't know GTA is coming?" Cameron offered a fairly compelling rebuttal: "The super-casual types who are still on a PS4 and need convincing that GTA 6 is worth getting back into games over." Lead SEO editor Lauren Morton likened it to a chocolate bar at the checkout counter: This isn't an exercise in persuasion, but flooding the zone.

Fraser was not persuaded, doubting the efficacy of the campaign. We got our first indication that something was amiss at 8:54 am. "A basketball stunt is so much more niche than, say, the Netflix trailer," Fraser argued. Niche? The Miami Heat? The multi-billion dollar NBA franchise with three championship victories to its name? The one that signed LeBron for a while in the 2010s and made everybody mad (I don't really know ball either)? That Miami Heat?
Then, the whammy: "I guess it's gonna land differently with Americans. To me, this is insanely niche. I had to google Miami Heat. "
More step forward

I was just logging on to work myself at this time, and was floored at what had transpired. I let Fraser know that this was the most British thing he had ever said. PC Gaming Show editorial director Jake Tucker tried to liken it to the international popularity of British football clubs, which did not help, because Fraser also does not follow footy. Lauren pointed out that Fraser was effectively saying, "I don't see the marketing value of sports because I don't follow sports." Fraser dug in.
"I get using sports teams for marketing, but it feels niche when it's one local sports team in one country . But maybe Miami Heat is an extremely big deal all over the world. I would never know!"

I pointed out how I've seen guys in Russia wearing Chicago Bulls jerseys, to which Fraser responded that he was aware of the Bulls and has even owned merch. If there is one takeaway from this whole debacle, it is not the manifest weakening of America's global cultural hegemony. It is instead the continued dominance and recognition of America's finest city, the Windy City. The City of Big Shoulders. Chi-Town, baby. Did you know we have a pope?
"I have heard of the Miami Dolphins," Fraser remarked, perhaps as some manner of conciliatory gesture to his American colleagues, "but only because they featured in Ace Ventura."

Then, the other shoe dropped: "[To be fair], I also don't know what a Miami Heat is," news writer Joshua Wolens, who lives in England, unhelpfully proffered. "But I generally assume I don't know most of what's happening in the modern world."

It was around this juncture that Fraser agreed to be subject to a formal write-up on PC Gamer dot com. I am not bullying my coworker. Buffalo-based PCG news writer Lincoln Carpenter helpfully reframed the argument at this time as well: "It's not so much that the Miami Heat specifically is a big deal. It's that NBA teams, as a rule, are big deals." Lincoln also shared Forbes' estimated valuations of the most expensive NBA teams in the world vs. the most expensive football clubs. For what it's worth, the basketball teams are more expensive.

At 9:06 am, UK-based social video editor Paul Broughton introduced the new argument that "basketballs are a myth created by 2K to sell their annual videogame," but I think it would be dishonest of me to add him to the counter. The work chat conversation then moved in different directions, but I was haunted.
Dateline: Lunch

I took my lunch break to play some of the Dark Souls 2 Seamless Co-op mod with PCG senior guides writer Sean Martin and freelance contributor Tyler Colp. I remarked on the Fraser/Miami Heat situation, and how I couldn't get it out of my head.
" What is the Miami Heat? " Sean sheepishly asked. Sean is also English.

At almost the exact same time, former PC Gamer editor-in-chief Samuel Roberts, who has returned for some freelance work and is also an Englishman, entered the chat. I thought he was a man of the world. I thought surely he would know ball.

"I learned what they are two hours ago!" Sam informed us. "I'm aware of the Miami Dolphins." Unlike Fraser, Sam did not come by this knowledge through the works of Jim Carrey, but rather some kind of hazy osmosis through American podcasts. Sam did know about the Bulls though (Chicago baby da Bulls baby etc.)

Then things took a turn for the strange. Senior editor Christopher Livingston, who has lived in the United States his entire life (and also Orlando, Florida for five years), revealed that he also probably couldn't have placed the Heat prior to this morning's events. Man, what the fuck.

I can't stress enough that I'm not a basketball guy. I don't know why this lack of Miami Heat brand recognition is bothering me so much. Is this how my UK colleagues feel when I don't know what a chip sandwich, Mr. Blobby, or a bank holiday is? I feel like I'm being pranked.

items.summary: Former NFL coach Mike Tomlin spent 19 seasons with the Pittsburgh Steelers and won Super Bowl LXIII, and now h

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/02/mike-tomlin-1790980579414.png
Former NFL coach Mike Tomlin spent 19 seasons with the Pittsburgh Steelers and won Super Bowl LXIII, and now he's added another major accomplishment to his resume: becoming a Minecraft YouTuber.

The former coach gave football fans a little something different when he launched his new YouTube channel earlier this week. With a profile picture taken in front of NBC's Football Night in America logo, watchers probably weren't expecting Tomlin's first upload to see him confess how his love for architecture and family led him to work on a Minecraft city he spent 12 years building.

"You know, 12 or 13 years ago, when my kids were in middle school, they'd be in their room all weekend and have friends over. They were obsessed with playing this game, Minecraft, that I knew nothing about," he explained as his son and channel operator, Dino, sat in the background. "I got interested because I just was mesmerized by what could occupy their attention for such large periods of time."

He admitted he lacked the "stick control" to handle something like Minecraft's Survival mode but still managed to find enjoyment in Creative Mode. That's where Mojang's systems really started to click.

"I like to build," he said. "I've always had an interest in architecture, and so forth, so I started doing this creative city. It was a means of spending time with them. They participated all over this city. All my kids have buildings."

However, as his kids went off to high school and college, their interest in Minecraft waned. For Tomlin, it was just beginning. In 2026, after 12 years of building, the sandbox phenomenon has become therapeutic for the former NFL coach, and what he's built has the internet in disbelief.

"This is where it all started for me," Tomlin said as a blocky blue pond surrounded by detailed city buildings faded into view. His tour then begins with a closer look at a hotel. This one building features a fully fleshed-out interior with labeled rooms, a lobby, a ballroom, a pool, bathrooms, and more. Tomlin even factored in how lighting might affect the views in some of these rooms – and that's just one of many locations he's made.
"I was always inspired," he added. "I'd go places, and I'd see things and buildings, and I get inspired, I go home, and I work on it."

Tomlin then referenced the off-campus housing around universities that he recreated after dropping Dino off at college. The color, floor plans, and other memorable elements all came from these memories, with much of his creation also built around different bodies of water.

Tomlin stepped down as the Steelers' coach in January 2026, with today's video showing how he's spent at least some of the downtime since. He spent years in the NFL, but it's his work as a Minecraft YouTuber that has everyone talking today.

"I'm obsessed why is he genuinely a better builder than me," content creator @Krtzyy said .
"Mike Tomlin becoming a Minecraft YouTuber was not on my bingo card for 2026," one X/Twitter user said .

Tomlin signed off, promising to take a closer look at his city in future videos. He also teased plans to show off something that "I think you're going to find interesting." Despite being maybe the most creative celebrity gamer to come out of 2026, the ex-NFL coach isn't the only notable name to share their love for gaming in the last year. Obsession breakout Inde Navarrette garnered attention for her The Last of Us and Call of Duty streams a few months ago . Newly announced X-Men star, Samara Weaving, is also a big gamer .

content.v: 《最终幻想7重制版》三部曲开发负责人滨口直树预计，随着大型角色扮演游戏的画面趋于写实，更多大型工作室将在中长期从传统回合制转向实时动作战斗。这是他对行业走向的判断，并非宣布某款游戏将改变战斗系统。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790980855_187211_jpg_r.jpg
滨口直树在接受Radio Times Gaming记者亚历克斯·赖斯贝克采访时谈到，高预算角色扮演游戏的画面越写实，许多玩家就越期待操作能得到迅速、贴近现实的反馈。开发者若想加强这种临场感，战斗设计便容易向动作玩法倾斜。讨论中他以《光与影：33号远征队》为例，比较了不同战斗系统带来的体验。
滨口直树同时强调，自己并不认为动作战斗在理念上优于回合制。在他看来传统回合制更接近卡牌对局或战术谜题，玩家可以停下来分析局势、选择行动；但从下达指令到角色完成攻击也会有时间间隔。他认为，这种节奏与现代大型游戏追求的写实画面及连续临场感较难协调。
《最终幻想7重制版》系列则结合了两种思路：玩家可以直接控制角色，也能通过战术暂停选择魔法和特殊招式。

content.v: 最近《魔法门之英雄无敌3》原版关卡设计师迈克尔·沃尔夫试玩重制版后，表示喜欢新版画面，同时提醒开发团队留意树木遮挡地图资源的问题，并希望游戏能使用原版配乐。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790980110_246641_jpg_r.jpg
《魔法门之英雄无敌3：重制版》视觉风格此前在原作玩家中引发分歧。开发团队表示会听取玩家意见，根据反馈调整风格，也承认找到合适的视觉风格并不容易。沃尔夫将自己的试玩过程发布到油管上，谈了他对画面和具体设计的看法。
沃尔夫认为，新版画面清晰，色彩比原版更有趣；他也注意到3D动画流畅，画面可以拉近。不过，他提醒开发团队检查地图上的资源是否会被树木挡住。按他的观察，游戏似乎不能旋转地图，如果资源因此不易发现，玩家辨认地图内容就会受到影响。
他还提到部分单位动画可以继续打磨，例如长枪兵待机时看起来像在费力喘气；原版制作时也遇到过类似问题。至于配乐，沃尔夫希望开发团队取得许可，使用保罗·安东尼·罗梅罗创作的原版音乐。他认为目前听到的音乐并不差，但无法替代自己熟悉的原版曲目。

items.title: Valve的补丁说明至上
items.summary: The king of patch notes reclaims its throne.

content.v: To most, the highlight of this week's big Deadlock patch is the snazzy map makeover, new heroes, and tons of quality-of-life additions. To me, it's all about the patch notes.

I spend a lot of waking hours reading white-text-on-black-background changelogs in this line of work, so when a page comes along that was specifically designed to be pleasant and exciting, it deserves to be rewarded. Valve has a long history of designing beautiful, bespoke webpages to introduce meaningful changes to its games, but the graphics department is really going ballistic with Deadlock.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/XDudrc7gxmfCGj3JXdAPbW-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2cvv2ju5QqhWMkShXbggtW-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/DmSGT7FpntgpF7fayjyESW-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nWSERqF9QWCptzPnafYTpV-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/RSupUYT9p4xB6qbBNdSgyW-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zSApKb9Kt8GzbkTqenwp6W-1920-80.jpg

The City Never Sleeps patch notes are styled like a tourism brochure for Deadlock's refreshed New York City, walking readers through scenic stops across the four major districts (Chinatown, Theater, Haunted Lot, and Plaza). Descriptions weave between in-world storytelling and technical explanation where it makes sense, with Valve's splashes of humor reminding readers not to take any of this too seriously.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3ZRh78ZRC8JPzsGHsA7HLW-1920-80.jpg

Dotted lines draw the reader to new points of interest as they scroll while furthering the map motif, and the page is stuffed with custom artwork for new items and mechanics that might only exist there. Valve did such an annoyingly good job with presenting the next era of Deadlock that I'm almost tempted to play a MOBA (but only almost).
Finally, some good food. Welcome back, Valve patch notes.
Valve's golden age of patch notes
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/sksMJSCbAWz7qdtyY7B9Nf-1920-80.jpg

It cannot be understated that Valve pioneered storytelling in multiplayer shooters with Team Fortress 2, arguably kicking off with the 2009 WAR! Update , aka "Soldier vs. Demo." This was before the concept of multiplayer games having seasons, before League of Legends had a TV show, before "live service" was even a thing—Valve had created a cast of nine lovable weirdos and new updates that weren't just dropping items, but telling stories that put the characters in conflict with one another and added context to the multiplayer maps we'd already been fighting in for two years.

It was weird in the first place for an FPS to receive so many free post-launch additions, and it was even weirder for a developer to treat the arrival of new weapons, modes, and hats as worthy of dedicated splash pages with accompanying comic books.

TF2 was the gold standard for post-launch support, and its patch notes drew massive interest, often dropping late on a Thursday or Friday, Pacific time, hinting that Valve may have been polishing until the last minute. Valve's blog posts were never the same month-to-month, often adopting new color schemes, layouts, and original elements for the occasion.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/5Pqmo2Vtm4ywq9QtJTUzWf-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2mSJLwTk2Tty8ELfNS7MyW-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zinxaSt4DRdLZ9fcRtmCoW-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nPJFwgnH2yppH6zMCQBahg-1920-80.jpg

There was no single template they stuck to. The Engineer update introduced his advanced Gunslinger gauntlet and Wrangler as blueprints with hand-written notes, while Scout's update debuted the Force-A-Nature scattergun in a department store catalog. I especially love announcing the Mac version of TF2 with a white, sanitized home page complete with symmetrical boxes and tiny text in the style of Apple circa 2002.
Poring over the "history" section of the TF2 website in 2026 is like uncovering one of those lost civilizations that invented a ton of sophisticated things before everyone else.

We're in an era marked by formulaic seasons, videogames as advertisement platforms, and teams scrambling to alter plans when they're not immediately popular . And yet 15 years ago, Valve had so much confidence in its direction that it could decide to wage a war between Soldier and Demoman one day (live-tracking the kills between both classes—Soldier narrowly won with 6.40M kills to the collective Demomen's 6.37M), introduce a crafting system the next, and then rebrand as Scream Fortress for October.

It wasn't exclusively good vibes—Valve caught flak for its (now quaint) paid hats, paid loot boxes, and speculative marketplace that became a fixture of updates. In a move that I would be surprised to see a studio make today, Valve made fun of itself at the time with a subsequent "Hatless Update" .

Deadlock's blogs are practically retro, it feels weird to say. I wonder what inspired Valve to go this hard again. Counter-Strike 2 and Dota 2's changelogs do not share the same sense of theater. Their patch notes are comparatively regular, functional bullet lists—perhaps in line with how often those games are updated. Valve does occasionally produce unique web pages for major CS2 announcements or Dota 2 events , but we're far from the days when an incremental Mann VS Machine update was announced with a lavish movie poster in the style of kaiju cinema.

TF2's exceptional, ever-changing patch notes were a reflection of the game they promoted. Valve leveraged the flexibility of an arena shooter and imagined a world where Red and Blu were real factions locked in stupid conflicts. You never really knew what elaborate scenarios Valve would think up next for its over-the-top action figures, and that filled TF2 fans with a sense of wonder that very few games have pulled off since. Maybe it's no coincidence that the only example of innovative multiplayer storytelling in recent years, Helldivers 2, is another over-the-top war game that finds comedy in the futility of endless violence.

Valve is tapping into that dormant TF2 energy in small ways with Deadlock, and it's great, though I wonder if, being a MOBA, the game's inherent sweat level will eventually lead to a regimented, low-nonsense future that's more focused on the minutiae of balance. Whatever Deadlock is up to years from now, I'll be keeping up with the patch notes.

items.summary: Apart from blatantly using the Fallout name, Fallout: New York was also completely AI generated, and it looks

content.v: I don't typically have much love for billion-dollar corporations dropping the 'meet our legal department' hammer on no-budget modders who are just trying to exercise their creative muscles, but in this one instance I'm willing to let it slide: Bethesda has issued a cease-and-desist order to an "AI creator" who made a Fallout game set in New York City that runs in browsers.

That's actually overstating it: As Chris First explained in his X feed (via RPS ), he " directed Claude and a studio of AI agents " to make the game for him. Nor was there any new creative thought injected into the process, First continued, saying he asked for a game that was "not inspired by" Fallout, but that was "exactly like Fallout."
This is the result.

Fallout: New York, a full Fallout game you play in your browser, built with Claude Opus 5.5.Quests. Dialogue trees. V.A.T.S. A working Pip-Boy.Zero texture files. Zero sound files. Every building, weapon, face and sound is generated by code. pic.twitter.com/58Vls0mOYx September 28, 2026

I know that being playable in a browser is a limiting factor, but this is really just something I'd rather not play at all. It stands in such sharp contrast to mods like Fallout: London or Skyblivion , efforts that reflect genuine passion, commitment, and creativity—and yes, those mods are massive undertakings that require years of effort from hundreds of volunteers, but they also don't suck and I feel like maybe there's a lesson to be learned there.

Anyway, whether I want to play it or not is now a moot point, because yesterday First said he received a message from ZeniMax Media telling him to knock it off —specifically, that the domain name he registered for the project, fallout.nyc, infringes on the studio's IP rights.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zN2CJJc9CjPEBFSBXRwL6N-1920-80.png

I don't know if First was expecting sympathy for his plight, but he doesn't seem to be getting much of it. Some responses criticize him for calling the project "Fallout," which is just about daring Bethesda to do something, but there's also plenty of heat over the use of AI to make the thing. A few optimists suggest First would be fine if he just changed the name, but he doesn't seem inclined to pursue that course.

That's probably for the best: Maybe I'm being overly harsh here (although I don't think so) but the one clear drawback to that plan is that changing the name doesn't change the fact that it looks like garbola. Playing a low-poly Fallout in a browser isn't an especially impressive technical feat—you can do the same with Morrowind , and it actually looks like Morrowind—and if you just want some really cheap Fallout, Fallout 3 is $2.49 in the Steam Autumn Sale, or you can snag New Vegas for a fiver.

content.v: 近日外媒GamesRadar报道称，前索尼互动娱乐美国总裁肖恩・莱登(Shawn Layden)在播客节目《The Expansion Pass》采访中表示，Xbox如今处境尴尬，根源在于微软一直没有选定并坚持一条清晰的发展路线。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790978172_818272_jpg_r.jpg
莱登指出近几年微软的游戏策略反复摇摆。在收购贝塞斯达、动视暴雪之后，微软一度把大量第一方游戏登陆 PS5 平台，后续又调转方向，宣布部分新作回归主机独占路线，策略来回变动，让外界看不清 Xbox 定位。
在他看来，微软面前摆着两条互不相容的道路，但无法同时做到两者兼顾。第一条路：继续做主机平台竞争者。作为游戏平台，就必须依靠独占内容支撑，缺少独占，平台本身就失去存在意义，任天堂、PlayStation都是依靠自家独占IP吸引用户购买硬件。
第二条路：放弃硬件竞争，转型成为全球顶级第三方发行商。手握动视暴雪、贝塞斯达庞大 IP 矩阵，如果做纯粹发行商，商业逻辑就要求游戏登陆全部平台，追求全渠道收益最大化。
他将Xbox当下局面比作世嘉的“Dreamcast时刻”，当年世嘉在DC失败后彻底退出硬件业务，转型纯软件发行商，这条道路是可以走通的。莱登建议Xbox新任负责人阿莎・夏尔马尽快做出抉择，二选一坚定走下去，不要在两种模式之间反复摇摆。
莱登坦言Xbox不是没有机会重新在主机市场展开竞争，但想要重回赛道，就必须在独占作品、争取第三方支持等方面做出对应的决断。如果选择做全球发行商，那就安心把全平台软件业务做到极致。想要同时兼顾平台与顶级发行商双重身份，现实层面很难取得成功。

items.title: 人工智能与教皇的争执：简要回顾
items.summary: The pope took on 'AI art' this week, saying that "there is an ontological difference ... between art and what

content.v: For a while now, AI guys have been arguing with the pope—Bishop of Rome, Primate of Italy, Chicago White Sox fan—over whether or not their chatbots and image generators are consistent with the will of the Lord, and in one recently-revealed exchange, whether making a computer talk constitutes creating life.
According to a New York Times report published this week, Anthropic lobbied the pope's advisers "to take the prospect of AI model consciousness seriously" back in May.

The pope, apparently unmoved, stated in his Magnifica Humanitas that "so-called artificial intelligences do not undergo experiences, do not possess a body, do not feel joy or pain, do not mature through relationships and do not know from within what love, work, friendship or responsibility mean."
Former White House technology adviser Dean Ball criticized the pope's letter at the time, saying it "puts the Church into the awkward role of the European technocratic regulatory advocate."
Ball is now head of strategic futures at OpenAI.
The latest in this ongoing beef between the pope and AI boosters is a new anti-slop message from His Holiness posted on X this week .

"In this era of artificial intelligence, it is becoming urgent to distinguish human art from what machines produce," wrote the pope. "There is an ontological difference, even before an aesthetic one, between art and what a machine can generate through statistical calculation based on millions of images created by others. Algorithms lack the spark of humanity. For this reason, the Church wishes to renew an alliance with artists and cultural institutions to safeguard our humanity."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zBnN6yftKNaf8xygeDumze-1920-80.jpg

Even on X, ruled as it is by the dunce king of tech and his Grok-riddled followers, there is a lot of support for the pope's stance. But of course there are also AI evangelists intent on schooling the Holy See about the beauty of "super intelligence," as it has been dubbed by people who must lack conviction in their own.
In one response I saw pointed out on Bluesky , the pope is asked "What about the Minions?" Indeed... what about them?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/BWi3Qg96wjXHHjSHmpM3ji-1920-80.png

With the battle lines drawn between powerful AI interests and the Catholic church, will the next Great Schism be over whether or not Claude is a real person? Will an AI thoughtleader ascend to pope-like status of their own?

An event like that wouldn't be out of place in '90s cyberpunk-comedy novel Snow Crash . I'd once assumed that those satirical visions of mad techno-cultists and lawless megacorps would manifest in a somehow more buttoned-up way, more 'realistically.' I gravely misjudged reality's capacity for farce.

A tangentially-related case-in-point: Palmer Luckey, the guy who invented the first decent consumer VR headset, is now a weapons mogul with a personal UH-60 Black Hawk helicopter . Deus Ex bosses are real, and they wear Hawaiian shirts.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/04/30/1-1777571355989.jpg
Disney has responded after rumors suggested it was interested in buying Fortnite developer Epic Games.

Disney president and chief creative officer Dana Walden touched on the company's relationship with Epic during an interview with Bloomberg Live . When asked if there have been talks about expanding their previously established relationship with a full-on acquisition, she said that strategy isn't something Disney is entertaining, at least right now.

"Well, I think that it was pretty obvious that we had very serious conversations about an investment and an equity stake," Walden responded. "Those are not the conversations we're having right now, but we have a great partnership and a number of launches coming up over the next two years that are going to demonstrate the value of this partnership."

The relationship referenced here was solidified when Disney announced it acquired a $1.5 billion stake in Epic back in early 2024. It was a massive play that it promised would result in collaborations across Fortnite and more in the future.

"Our exciting new relationship with Epic Games will bring together Disney’s beloved brands and franchises with the hugely popular Fortnite in a transformational new games and entertainment universe," then-CEO Bob Iger said. "This marks Disney’s biggest entry ever into the world of games and offers significant opportunities for growth and expansion. We can’t wait for fans to experience the Disney stories and worlds they love in groundbreaking new ways."

We're still feeling the shockwaves of that deal, but some suspected it could evolve into more than a simple partnership. Tech reporter Alex Heath said in March 2026 that some Disney executives were "waiting for that moment" to go all in on an acquisition . Then, in April, Bloomberg reported that Epic was working on an extraction shooter featuring Disney characters with plans to launch in November 2026.

We're now kicking off October with no official mention of that unannounced project, but that doesn't mean Disney x Epic is going anywhere any time soon. While an acquisition isn't in the cards, Walden's promise regarding "a number of launches" set to arrive in the next few years suggests there is plenty more to talk about.

We'll have to wait and see how the two entertainment giants work together moving forward. In the meantime, you can read some of the other ways Disney and Epic have bolstered their relationship, including a Disneyland-exclusive Fortnite skin and officially licensed Star Wars minigames .

items.title: 我一直对万代南梦宫即将推出的高达游戏持怀疑态度，但后来我看到了这个模型套件的电锯 macuahuitl
items.summary: It's a compelling argument.

content.v: Doctors have confirmed it: It's physically impossible for me to turn my nose up at a mecha action game. But despite this dire prognosis, I've been suspicious of Gundam Rogue Orbit—Bandai Namco's mobile suit action game coming in spring—since it was announced back in June .

The problem is the giant monsters. I'm a Gundam traditionalist. Gundam, to me, isn't about fighting aliens—it's about traumatized child war pilots becoming so psychic that their brains explode. But this week, Bandai found a way to coax me off my high horse: With an extremely sick model kit.
【全日本ホビーショー 情報解禁＆初展示✨】HG 1/144 バウバラム 情報解禁！ガンダムゲーム最新作『GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT』より、バウバラムがHGシリーズで登場！！ホビーサイトでの続報をお待ちください！https://t.co/XoaJUr7vZa#ガンプラ #プラモデル pic.twitter.com/Y780tB7BUE October 2, 2026

My time at PC Gamer has coincided with my steady descent into Gundam model kit obsession: I'm currently at the stage of manually re-scribing mold lines, so the outlook is grim. As a result, I was particularly prone to react when yesterday, as part of its reveal lineup for the 2026 All Japan Model & Hobby Show, Bandai announced the HG 1/144 Bau Bahlam—a model kit incarnation of a mobile suit we'll see in Rogue Orbit. Look at this thing:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UYonKCRTJkbokJk4Xw9kJW-1920-80.jpg

The Bau Bahlam was briefly visible in Rogue Orbit's release date trailer back in September, but these model kit renders are the first time I've properly taken in the design. Here's what jumps out at me:

It's impressively menacing, and—if the mecha customization shown in the release date trailer is any indication—we'll probably be able to use its various bits on our own robot. Hopefully that includes the macuahuitl. It'd be cruel not to.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WtHRDdxBxFP4kq7xFSxo94-1920-80.jpg

I still reserve the right to be obnoxious about Rogue Orbit's departure from the traditional Gundam conceptual palette once it actually launches, but rolling out impressive mecha designs like these is an effective way of softening me up in the meantime. Surely, a game willing to give its robots giant Mesoamerican chainswords has to have its heart in the right place.
Gundam Rogue Orbit launches on Steam on March 4, 2027. The HG 1/144 Bau Bahlam kit doesn't have a release date, but it's expected to be available sometime in 2027.

content.v: 近日Riot Games联合创始人Marc Merrill接受采访，谈及《英雄联盟》MMO时承认开发这类游戏有不少难题，但团队仍愿意尝试。他认为，符文之地已有庞大的玩家基础，许多玩家熟悉这个世界，希望能在其中生活。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790973993_369981_jpg_r.jpg
Merrill在Lemonade Stand播客中表示，外界对项目的担忧有根据。MMO开发规模庞大，玩家期待高，受众也常被认为相对有限。提问者还谈到，部分资深玩家随着年龄增长，可支配的游玩时间减少，市场上已有《魔兽世界》等大型作品。Merrill说，认为团队不该开发这款游戏，确实有许多看起来合理的理由。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261003/1790973994_677934_jpg_r.jpg
他同时指出，Riot长期建设符文之地，全球已有大量玩家熟悉并喜爱其中的角色、阵营和世界。公司也拥有玩家基础、收入来源和开发团队。他说，玩家希望生活在这个世界中，团队希望提供这样的体验。
Riot另一款游戏《2XKO》已宣布停止积极开发，这也让部分玩家对MMO的前景保持谨慎。谈到项目本身，Merrill认为关键在于做出配得上《英雄联盟》这一知识产权的作品；如果试图满足所有人，游戏可能因过度折中而失去明确方向。

items.title: Vibe-Coded Mashup Mods 本周已占据 X 市场
items.summary: I have spent the last three days scrolling through some of the most insane mod videos I've ever seen. Modders

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/02/vibecodedmods-explainer-blogroll-1790975025611.jpg

I have spent the last three days scrolling through some of the most insane mod videos I've ever seen. Modders are taking games that have been decompiled with Claude, and mashing them up with other games. As the week has gone on, there have only been more clips of these mods pouring out on X/Twitter.

One person created a mashup of World of Warcraft and Call of Duty: World at War ; another combined Escape From Tarkov with Skyrim . There’s even one that takes Insomniac’s Spider-Man and combines it with Batman Arkham City , where the player is able to swing around Batman’s turf.

These mods are everywhere online right now, though they thankfully haven’t filtered into modding websites like Nexus Mods yet. But, with the sheer volume of these mods and with how accessible Opus 5.5 is, it feels like it’s only a matter of time before the gates are fully torn down. And if that happens, it could change the face of the modding scene entirely.
Why Now?

Claude Opus 5.5 launched last week, promising cheaper tokens and more efficient code work. I'm sure that Anthropic meant for it to be used by professionals, but gamers have used it to create some of the weirdest mods I have ever seen.

Opus is a model that can power AI agents, which can be deployed to create entire games from the engine, to the art and enemy behavior. Brendan Jowett has a great video on YouTube of the model in action: He develops little slices of video games and compares them directly with the same tasks from OpenAI’s Astra 6 model. While the results of both are far from what you’d expect from a fully featured game, Claude’s new model has clearly come a long way.

The problem with the examples in Jowett’s video is that while the models are good at piecing together disparate parts of a game, enemy AI (lol) and art assets are lackluster to say the least. In one of the slices, a space combat sim, the space fighter flys at a diagonal angle, while moving in a straight line ahead, and shooting. In another slice enemies completely ignore the player character.

As good as Claude Opus 5.5 seems to be, it’s still lightyears away from developing something like a true mashup of Minecraft and Elden Ring from scratch. But the model doesn’t have to start from scratch.

The big, driving force behind a lot of these mods is decompilation, where people are pointing Opus at a game and letting the agent break it down to its source code (here’s a handy blog if you want to really get in the weeds). Just earlier today, we covered Halo: Combat Evolved being decompiled and ported to run natively in a browser . Once that step is complete, it takes little effort to take that source code and work huge swaths of games into other games as mods, and with very little input from the user.

Couple that with the relatively affordable tokens, and it shouldn’t be surprising that X/Twitter’s generally pro-AI users went wild with it, creating hundreds of mashups. And it doesn’t seem like it’s slowing down any time soon; what started off as a weird video that my boss sent me on Tuesday has now evolved to the point where I can’t even open X/Twitter without seeing a deluge of these mods.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/02/18/likeadragonhawaii-blogroll-1739839417413.jpg
Piracy?

The obvious problem with all of this is that these models are breaking open games developed by real people, getting the source code and then just mashing stuff together without consideration or permission from the original developers. That’s nothing particularly new – the modding scene is definitely no stranger to mashups, all the Thomas the Tank Engine mods are proof of that. However, this trend might be breaking into new territory, thanks to decompilation.

This could be another reason none of these mods have made their way onto any distribution platforms. Nexus Mods doesn’t outright ban AI-generated content, but it doesn’t let people use AI tools to upload content that they don’t have the rights to.

In a blog post from 2023, Nexus laid out its rules around AI generated content. The policy states that , “In order to prevent any issues with your mods, we encourage you to avoid using these tools unless you have explicit permission to use all the assets. This is particularly true for AI-generated voice acting but also covers images, models, code and anything else that you can use this technology to create.”

Every single one of these passthrough mods are using images, models, and code that the people generating them don’t have the rights to. But it’s only a matter of time until some platform holder allows these mods to be hosted, and I’m sure a massive legal battle will happen immediately afterwards.
The Modding Community Hates This

Way before all of these Claude-authored mod videos started cropping up online, people had been creating mods by hand for years, typically out of pure love for the game. It shouldn’t be surprising, then, that a lot of mod authors aren’t fans of this phenomenon.

Mod authors have been expressing their frustration on X/Twitter as this has been happening. “I mod games and I'm not shy about the fact that I use AI to do it. I hate this bullshit ‘trend’. Pure slop, there's nothing creative about this at all,” kran27_ posted. “AI has a lot of potential in the modding scene, but the shit that's getting the clicks is this jingling keys bullshit.”

Kran wasn’t alone, with discountmodder ready to just leave the scene, saying, “Dude I'm really disappointed. If this becomes the permanent state of modding, this may be my last project. I don't wanna be involved in an AI slop-factory.”

I can’t escape the feeling that most of these mashups are born from people just playing with a new AI model and seeing what will happen, and I hope that this weird trend will die off soon. Modding is one of the best parts of PC gaming, and there is a lot of incredible content that people make just because they love a game. Some of the best games started off as mods, after all, and without them we never would have got the likes of Half-Life or League of Legends.

I hope that this is just a trend, rather than a sign of where the modding scene is heading. Fortunately, because these mods seemingly only exist to farm engagement on Twitter (at least so far), you don’t have to worry too much about them if you just want to start a new modded run of The Witcher 3 Remastered. If anything, it just means that if you want to avoid AI content, you need to pay even more attention to who you’re getting your mods from.

items.title: 30年后，他们终于让《皇牌空战》的导演驾驶真正的喷气式飞机，我很荣幸
items.summary: This is what a man looks like after fulfilling a lifelong dream.

content.v: Kazutoki Kono: You're welcome.

Back in June , I asked the Ace Combat brand director, who's been working on the series since 1997's Ace Combat 2, if he'd ever gotten to strap into an F-16 and experience the real thrills of doing barrel rolls at 30,000 feet. "Unfortunately over the last 30 years of my career I've been appealing, saying 'hey, we want to ride in one of these jets!' but we have not yet had the chance," Kono said at the time. "Neither myself, or anyone on the team."

Mere months later, it's a whole new world. In a promotional video released today alongside Ace Combat 8, Bandai Namco revealed that Kono finally got to climb into the cockpit of a jet and live the real life version of the series he's been overseeing for years and years. Well, minus the combat parts.

"I was scared before getting in. But once we were airborne, it turned into one of the most beautiful experiences," he said in the video. "The G-force during turns was noticeable, but what stood out the most was the force pushing me downward into the seat. Being up in the sky inside such a compact cockpit felt incredible. It was a surprisingly comfortable and enjoyable space to be in. Compared to a large aircraft, it really made me appreciate the appeal of fighter jets."

One way to look at this sequence of events is to see the ad as a logical and inevitable marketing step for a series that Bandai Namco has clearly put more money behind than ever before, including a live-action YouTube miniseries . The other way to look at it—as I'm choosing to—is that the public outcry after my groundbreaking interview was published reached a level of fervor that simply could not be ignored. It may have only gotten one comment on pcgamer.com , but the ripples must've been felt all the way over in Tokyo.

Clearly the people demanded Kazutoki Kono be given the chance to soar that big blue sky, and the money men had no choice but to pay for our guy to hitch a ride in a MiG-21. Whatever it cost, it was clearly worth it. Look at Kono in his post-flight interview. He's glowing!
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qWy6Uv5qcGu2bEC2imd37P-1920-80.jpg

That's the look of a man who's just had his dream fulfilled. And even after having just experienced the wonder of flight at a speed and intimacy few on this earth will ever know themselves, he remained steadfast in his duty as brand director.
"Looking out at the clouds and the sky while flying, I couldn't help but think how Ace Combat is incredibly well-made," he said. No argument here .

items.title: GTA 6 截图表明它不会羞于引用电影
items.summary: A new screenshot from Grand Theft Auto 6 has arrived, and fans immediately noticed that it appears to be refer

content.v: A new screenshot from Grand Theft Auto 6 has arrived, and fans immediately noticed that it appears to be referencing the iconic opening scene from Quentin Tarantino's 1994 crime movie Pulp Fiction.

The image was shared by Love magazine on Instagram . The GTA 6 Countdown social media account put it next to the diner scene from Pulp Fiction, and the similarities are there, especially in the framing.

In Pulp Fiction, Tim Roth and Amanda Plummer's characters, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny, go on to rob the diner, and given that Lucia and Jason are criminals as well, it's not a stretch to think that could happen in GTA 6. Maybe they're just enjoying breakfast, but that seems unlikely given the image clearly shows both gripping their pistols, with Lucia seemingly ready to fill the empty duffel bag next to her with cash and other valuables.

GTA 6 tells a Bonnie and Clyde-style story of two lovers who are also criminals. Things did not end well for them, and many are speculating as to how GTA 6's story could wrap up for both Lucia and Jason. It also wouldn't be surprising to see GTA 6 reference Pulp Fiction given how GTA games in the past have featured very overt references to movies, like how Vice City had Scarface references and GTA 5 had nods to Heat.

"We wanted both protagonists to be vulnerable, tough, flawed, right sometimes, wrong sometimes, able to learn from each other,”GTA 6 writer Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern told Love magazine. “That’s what we felt made them authentic, and a great team.”
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Jason_and_Lucia_13_0038a1.jpg?w=636

Another GTA 6 game writer, Alexa D’Agostino, told the magazine, “When you are focusing on writing a fully realized person with their own wants, you’re going to get something perfectly imperfect--with clichés, but also undeniably real.”

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. On November 18, the Miami Heat will wear GTA 6-inspired jerseys and play on a court that references Vice City, the game's setting, and a stand-in for Miami.
GTA 6 will take players outside of Miami to other places in Florida, just don't expect to go to Rockstar's version of Walt Disney World .

items.title: 亲爱的前 NFL 主教练 Mike Tomlin：你的 12 年 Minecraft 城市很美丽
items.summary: It may or may not have contributed to the Steelers' years of postseason woes—but at least it's walkable.

content.v: By the time he stepped down as head coach of the Pittsburgh Steelers in 2025, Mike Tomlin—then the NFL's longest-tenured coach—had led the team through a 19-year run without a losing season, securing 13 playoff appearances, eight division titles, and a victory at Super Bowl XLIII.

Since 2014, however, Tomlin has been answering a higher calling: He's been building. In a YouTube video on Wednesday, he unveiled his true masterwork: A sprawling Minecraft metropolis that he's been meticulously hand-sculpting for the last 12 years. And it's magnificent.

As the video starts, Tomlin—PlayStation controller in hand—explains that he was introduced to Minecraft by his children, who were obsessed with the game during their middle school years. While he didn't have much history with videogames, he was "mesmerized by what could occupy their attention," and as he's "always had an interest in architecture," he naturally gravitated to Minecraft's creative mode.
Eventually, his kids moved on to other interests—but Tomlin remained transfixed by the "therapeutic" act of crafting buildings, communities, and neighborhoods.
"It allowed me to detach from the realities and pressures of life," Tomlin says. "Let's take you through it."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Kt7P5EdNDcLsn9konjTGkk-1920-80.png

The video then transitions to Tomlin's first-person view as he surveyed his works from on high, revealing the purest product of a grown man's hyperfixation I've ever seen: a waterfront district, with a bay surrounded by skyrises, hotels, and apartment blocks—each with its own color schemes, exterior detailing, balconies, courtyards, balustrades, awnings, and plazas.
"I started small," he says.

The former NFL coach then takes us on a tour of his city's first completed building, a "boutique hotel" built from cut red sandstone with marble and birchwood walkways, featuring—as Tomlin casually explains—a multi-floor executive spa with therapy rooms, a glass-ceilinged multi-purpose conference room, an indoor-outdoor restaurant with balcony seating, and "appropriate amenities" like public restrooms with sinks and stalls recreated from cleverly repurposed Minecraft fixtures.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/rNx5qLzpsoU6NJqNY3FiQF-1920-80.png
It also has a basement speakeasy with a glowstone-illuminated window looking out into the hotel pool. With an adjacent employee area. And kitchen.

The tour continues through themed residential high rises-slash-aquariums with detailed bedroom interiors, past recreated CVS pharmacies, baseball fields, and soccer stadiums, and over rooftop penthouses. Throughout, Tomlin reiterates how he tried to consider both function and aesthetics by keeping conscious of interior lighting and what types of views building occupants would enjoy.

It's delightful —but it may not have been entirely delightful for the Steelers. Since he presented his city on Wednesday, many have noted that the years in which he would've been building his Minecraft magnum opus overlapped with the team's declining playoff performance .

From his first season as head coach in 2007 to 2013, the Steelers had a postseason win rate of 62.5%. Between Tomlin breaking ground on his Minecraft city in 2014 and stepping down as head coach in 2025, however, the team's postseason win rate was a mere 25%.
